title: HATCH gradient-name retained owner fast slice
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated controls
scope: Charge the DXF HATCH group-470 gradName string to the parsed entity owner lease
Preserve replacement, copy/move, and reset accounting behavior
Use generated ASCII controls without adding persistent DWG/DXF fixtures

implementation.summary: DRW_Hatch::parseCode now passes group 470 through replaceDxfRetainedStringField with a dedicated byte counter. The explicit copy constructor and assignment preserve the count with the gradient name and shared base lease; default moves transfer accounting, and reset clears/releases the field.
implementation.layoutChange: A private retained-byte counter was added to public DRW_Hatch layout. Downstream consumers must rebuild; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.

commands: git diff --check -- src/drw_entities.h src/drw_entities.cpp tests/hardening_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md docs/research/hatch-gradient-name-retained-owner-fast-slice-2026-10-17.json

assessment.claim: The selected parser-owned DXF HATCH group-470 string is charged to the shared logical retained-byte budget and its lease follows copies until final reset/destruction. Cap-minus-one admission preserves the previous gradient name and leaves its charge intact. This does not bound allocation capacity, RSS, public mutation, writer copies, or all HATCH fields.
assessment.coverage: Generated ASCII controls cover pattern and gradient name replacement, minimum accepted aggregate budget, exact-cap success, one-byte-under preservation, copy construction/assignment, move construction/assignment, and final reset release.
assessment.limitations: Per-stop color-book names (groups 432/433), HATCH boundary/pattern semantics, DWG decoding, public post-parse mutation, writer/projection copies, peer/native execution, and full-suite behavior are outside this slice.
